K2.0 1000W Electric Mountain Bike – Power, Performance, and Precision
Experience the ultimate off-road adventure with the K2.0 1000W Electric Mountain Bike. Designed for thrill-seekers and outdoor enthusiasts, this high-performance e-bike combines cutting-edge technology, rugged durability, and unmatched power to conquer any terrain. Whether you're tackling steep hills, cruising through trails, or commuting in style, the K2.0 delivers an exhilarating ride every time.

Why Choose the K2.0 1000W Electric Mountain Bike?

Perfect for Off-Road Adventures: Built to handle rugged trails, steep climbs, and fast descents.

Versatile & Reliable: Ideal for commuting, trail riding, or exploring the great outdoors.

Eco-Friendly Transportation: Reduce your carbon footprint without sacrificing performance.

1. Unmatched Power & Speed:

BaFang M620 Mid-Drive Motor: 48V 1000W sustained power (1250W peak) for effortless climbing and acceleration.

Up to 31 MPH: Achieve top speeds on both pedal assist and throttle modes.

2. Long-Lasting Battery:

Removable Internal Lithium-ion Battery: Choose between 15AH (720WH) or 20AH (960WH) Samsung cells for extended rides.

45-55 Mile Range: Perfect for long adventures or daily commutes.

3. Premium Build & Durability:

6061 Double-Butted Aluminum Alloy Frame: Lightweight yet sturdy, with an integrated battery for a sleek design.

Max Payload Capacity: Supports riders up to 275 lbs.

4. Advanced Electric System:

48V 1000W Frame-Integrated Controller: Ensures smooth power delivery and efficient performance.

Intelligent 5-Level Pedal Assist: Combines speed and torque sensors for a seamless riding experience.

5. Superior Components for Any Terrain:

Suntour XCM34 Hydraulic Suspension Fork: 120mm travel with lockout and preload adjustment for smooth handling.

Tektro Hydraulic Disc Brakes: 203mm front and 180mm rear rotors for reliable stopping power.

Shimano Alivio 9-Speed Drivetrain: Precision shifting for all riding conditions.

Maxxis 27.5x2.8 Tires: Tackle rough trails with confidence.

6. Rider-Focused Design:

BAFANG DP C18.UART LCD Display: Monitor speed, battery life, and assist levels with ease.

High-Output 100 LUX LED Headlight & Red LED Taillight: Stay visible and safe during night rides.
